title: Gutenberg's printing press
summary: The goldsmith Gutenberg combined metal movable type cast in a hand mould with a press to print quickly.
why: Revolutionized book production and helped spread the Reformation and the Scientific Revolution.
interchange: Movable type was made earlier in China (Bi Sheng, c. 1040) and Korea (metal type; Jikji, 1377); whether it influenced Europe is debated

notes.problem: 'Started... shaped the Renaissance' is stronger than source ('revolutionized', 'contributing to the Reformation and the Scientific Revolution'); interchange not shown independent: Movable type page calls East-West transmission debated.
